name: marketplace-database
description: Docker + TimescaleDB + Flyway setup for marketplace database

scripts.db:setup: docker-compose up -d postgres && docker-compose up flyway && npm run db:wait && npm run db:seed && npm run db:verify
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:teardown && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup:podman: podman compose up -d postgres && podman compose up flyway && npm run db:wait && npm run db:seed && npm run db:verify
scripts.db:reset:podman: npm run db:teardown:podman && npm run db:setup:podman
